title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context. In cote 147 Grothendieck studies the stratification at infinity of the Deligne–Mumford compactification of M_{g,ν}. An MD-graph G is the stable dual graph of a stable marked curve. Each vertex α carries a genus g_α, a marked weight ν_α (number of marked points on that component) and an order μ̃_α (number of half-edges at α, loops counted twice). The open stratum is M_G ≅ (∏_α M_{g_α, ν_α+μ̃_α}) / Γ_G, of modular dimension δ(G) = Σ_α (3g_α − 3 + ν_α + μ̃_α), as in (67).

Previous page. δ(G)=1 means exactly one vertex α0 has δ_{α0}=1 and every other vertex has δ_α=0. A vertex with δ_α=0 is a 3-pointed P^1, i.e. g_α=0 and ν_α+μ̃_α=3. The vertex α0 is either:
- genus 1 with total weight 1, or
- genus 0 with total weight 4.

This page.
(70) gives the 'elementary' (single-vertex, 'ponctuel') cases:
- one genus-0 vertex with 4 marked points, Γ=S_4 and Γ^!=1;
- one genus-1 vertex with 1 marked point, Γ=Γ^!=1.
These are M_{0,4} and M_{1,1} themselves.

All other dimension-1 cases fall into two types:
- (a) all vertices of genus 0, every vertex trivalent in the weighted sense (ν̂_α=ν_α+μ̃_α=3) except one, α0, with ν̂_{α0}=4 and 1≤μ̃_{α0}≤4;
- (b) all vertices genus 0 and trivalent except a genus-1 'end vertex' α0 with μ̃_{α0}=1 and ν_{α0}=0 (an elliptic tail); the other vertices have 1≤μ̃_α≤3 and ν_α=3−μ̃_α.

(71) In either case there is a canonical isomorphism M̂_G ≅ M̂_{g_{α0}, Î_{α0}}, where Î_{α0} = I_{α0} ⊔ Ã_{α0} is the set of marked points plus half-edges at α0. Its cardinality is 4 if g_{α0}=0 and 1 if g_{α0}=1. All other factors are points M_{0,3}.

Next page. The action of Γ_G on this curve is trivial in the genus-1 case and factors through S_{Î} ≅ S_4 in the genus-0 case. He then lists the dimension-1 strata inside ambient modular dimension 2. In modern terms these are the one-dimensional boundary strata ('F-curves'), each the image of M̄_{0,4} or M̄_{1,1}. This feeds the program of the Esquisse: the Teichmüller tower is to be controlled by its modular dimensions ≤2.
errors: The inserted parenthesis '(g_{α0}=0, g_α=1)' should read (g_{α0}=0, g_{α0}=1): both alternatives concern the special vertex α0. This is probably a misreading or a slip of the pen.

In case (a) the non-special vertices need not form a tree. Loops and multiple edges are allowed in the count μ̃ (e.g. a genus-0 vertex with a loop has μ̃ = 2). So the description of 'rétrocentraux' graphs as tree-like, if intended, would be incomplete. The conditions as stated in terms of μ̃ are nonetheless correct.

The isomorphism (71) is fine for the rigidified product. At the level of stacks one must still remember the residual Γ_G action and the generic ±1 automorphism of M_{1,1}. Grothendieck treats this on the next page; it is not an error, just left implicit here.

ideas.what: Classification of one-dimensional boundary strata of M̄_{g,n}: one special vertex of type (0,4) or (1,1), all other vertices 3-pointed rational. Each stratum is canonically M_{0,4} or M_{1,1}.
ideas.usually_credited_to: Faber; Keel–McKernan (1996); Gibney–Keel–Morrison (2002), in the context of the F-conjecture
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984) discusses modular dimensions 1 and 2 of the Teichmüller tower, without this explicit classification

ideas.what: Modular dimension δ(G)=Σ(3g_α−3+ν_α+μ̃_α) of a stratum indexed by a stable dual graph.
ideas.modern_name: dimension of the boundary stratum M_Γ

ideas.what: Action of the graph automorphism group on the stratum factoring through S_4 on the 4 special points or half-edges.
ideas.modern_name: automorphism group of a stable graph acting on a boundary stratum

deep.surprise_reason: This is a careful but routine enumeration of the one-dimensional boundary strata (F-curves) of M̄_{g,n}, part of the dimension ≤2 analysis behind the Esquisse's Teichmüller tower program. It is historically interesting as an early, Grothendieck-specific formulation, but it contains nothing a specialist would find new.
transcription_corrections: The inserted parenthesis is better read '(g_{α0}=0, g_{α0}=1)', not '(g_{α0}=0, g_α=1)'.
The vertical margin note appears to read 'MD-graphes élémentaires (comment ... ... isolé ...)'. It probably annotates the elementary single-vertex cases of (70).
Page number '56' is written at bottom left.
